function.name: report_gas_emergency
function.description: FIRST action for a current suspected gas smell or leak, even mid-booking. This tool plays fixed evacuation and 911 guidance BEFORE the backend request. Do not use update_intake first or ask administrative questions. Do not use for a merely hypothetical question. No one is contacted or dispatched.

caller_quote.description: Actual short caller quote reporting the suspected gas smell.

messages.content: Leave the area with everyone now. Don't use switches or appliances. Once safely away, call 911.
